Global.Text 412463 'Become a Soccer Star' and 412464 'Learn how to be a soccer star by finding Manager Landon in Snowhill.' (lab/reports/locale-id-to-text.json); Manager Landon is the job_trainers.json trainer for profile 52 (npc 9000000140).

(R) T542: the original was started from the Jobs window (147/1 row, then 49/15 with original quest id 1965); the giver is the trainer Manager Landon (9000000140), the single talk target is the same trainer, and the turn-in is the giver, so one Talk to the trainer completes the step and opens the end screen there. Reward: 5 coins (the W110 fallback for an unknown payout) and no job XP, so a locked profile can never block the turn-in. No intro, prerequisite or job gate is bound; because the giver is the trainer, the trainer's own menu also offers it.
